component.name: Bluzy
component.summary: Turn your laptop into a Bluetooth speaker

description.p: Bluzy lets you use your Ubuntu laptop as a wireless Bluetooth speaker. Enable Speaker Mode and connect your phone — audio plays through your laptop's speakers instantly.

ul.li: One-toggle Bluetooth Speaker Mode (A2DP Sink)
Real-time connection status and device name display
System tray icon with quick controls
Configurable speaker name and pairing confirmation
Auto-connect memory for trusted devices
Volume control for incoming audio
Independent audio output selection and Bluetooth playback volume
Native GNOME look and feel with Libadwaita

description.p: Correct independent output selection to follow VLC's PulseAudio stream routing.

ul.li: Move only incoming Bluetooth playback to the chosen output
Leave shared ports, desktop defaults and unrelated apps unchanged
Control Bluetooth stream volume instead of shared device volume
Stop forcing profiles on unrelated Bluetooth audio devices

description.p: Choose where your Bluetooth audio plays directly in Bluzy.

ul.li: Audio output selector for speakers, headphones, USB, HDMI, and other active outputs
Separate speaker and headphone ports on the same sound card
Remembered output with automatic discovery and reconnect fallback
Bluetooth playback routing and volume for the selected output
Background discovery and switching keep the interface responsive
Bluetooth Speaker Mode toggle
Real-time connection status
System tray integration
Auto-connect device memory
Volume control
